text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf and I finish training just as the sun is starting to set.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew. Another productive session.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Air Groove. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I was hoping to discuss some issues that have arisen in the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Ah. I see you've just finished training. My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If anything, I'm happy you came to me so promptly. Please, continue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In that case, the problems are related to the infrastructure of the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The immediate issues have been patched over, but the student council will need to conduct a thorough examination sooner rather than later.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That said, I foresee no problems in waiting until tomorrow. How would you like to handle this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To tell the truth, I was meaning to hold a meeting with my trainer after this…
choice_data_list: Why don't you sort out this issue today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you for understanding.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, there you have it, Air Groove. It seems I am free after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very good.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then I'm off to clear things up. I'll see you tomorrow, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Symboli Rudolf's efforts, the issues are resolved within the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's impressive how readily she prioritizes her duties, especially when she must be tired from training… but then again, she is the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… I may very well take you up on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, I do not wish to keep the students waiting. Would you help me address this promptly?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pitch in to help, and together we manage to resolve the issues before the day is out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems I've managed to take some of the weight off her shoulders.
